WITH invoice_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_avg_price) as overall_avg
  FROM invoice_avgs
),
deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    ia.InvoiceId,
    ia.Country,
    ia.invoice_avg_price,
    ia.invoice_avg_price - oa.overall_avg as deviation
  FROM invoice_avgs ia
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
country_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    Country,
    AVG(deviation) as country_avg_deviation
  FROM deviations
  GROUP BY Country
),
final_results AS (
  SELECT 
    d.InvoiceId,
    d.Country,
    d.invoice_avg_price,
    d.deviation,
    d.deviation - cad.country_avg_deviation as final_value
  FROM deviations d
  JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON d.Country = cad.Country
)
SELECT *
FROM final_results
ORDER BY final_value IS NULL, final_value DESC
LIMIT 10
